title: (RHBA-2019:0207) sbd bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated sbd packages that fix one bug are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.

portal_description:
The sbd packages provide integration with hardware-based watchdogs allowing the SBD utility to be used as a cluster-fencing device. SBD watches the cluster process and initiates a hardware reset if one of the processes fails or the node loses quorum.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the sbd-daemon always triggered a reboot when it detected a timeout. If there was a hardware watchdog configured to trigger a poweroff, there would be a race between the poweroff and a reboot with potential result of an undesired reboot. In case of a usage without a hardware watchdog, there was no way to trigger a poweroff at all if that was the desired action. With this update, configuration allows to set the desired action and it is possible to trigger a reliable poweroff. (BZ#1666202)

Users of sbd are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
